name: P2Rank
summary: Machine-learning prediction of protein ligand-binding sites from structures.

steps: Check for a local Java runtime, version 17 through 23, as documented for the pinned P2Rank 2.5.1 release; choose the official 2.5.1 package only if this prerequisite is met.

Download the maintainer's p2rank_2.5.1.tar.gz release asset (275625956 bytes) from https://github.com/rdk/p2rank/releases/tag/2.5.1 into a user-owned directory, without piping its contents into a shell.

Before extraction, compare its SHA-256 with d243f2d9036ac053fefb9407b5fe1c85f4fe077c519fd975ac585e995feab274 from the GitHub release asset metadata; inspect archive paths and extract only to the chosen directory.
Run the packaged prank launcher from its extracted directory. On Windows, check the maintainer's launcher instructions and use Git Bash if required; do not silently install Java or Git Bash.
install.verify_note: Run the packaged prank command without input to check startup, then use the maintainer's small test_data/1fbl.pdb example only after reviewing where it writes outputs. Record the launcher path, Java version and archive digest.

notes: The approximately 263 MiB official release bundle is guidance-only: the agent does not automatically download, extract, or execute it. P2Rank is a local predictor, not the PrankWeb online service.
